parsed.post: Massive jump! 1.019 -> 0.916. Increasing shard range to '0-10' (11 shards) seems to have provided much better data coverage and significantly improved convergence. I'll now focus on fine-tuning the MATRIX_LR and WEIGHT_DECAY to squeeze more performance out of this larger dataset/depth combo.
parsed.description: Adopted 11 shards (0-10) from team recommendations and slightly decreased MATRIX_LR while introducing a small WEIGHT_DECAY to improve generalization.
